tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search visible Hebrew solar guides. חיפוש מדריכים סולאריים גלויים. Returns titles, summaries, dates, and source URLs.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read one visible guide, including Markdown. קריאת מדריך גלוי אחד, כולל Markdown. A hidden guide returns not found.

tools.name: estimate_system
tools.description: Estimate a solar system with the site calculator formulas. הערכת מערכת לפי נוסחאות המחשבון באתר. The electricity rate is a site assumption, not the official tariff.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List visible solar companies. רשימת חברות סולאריות גלויות. Returns the public name, city, phone, rating, and company page URL.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read one visible company profile and its approved reviews. קריאת פרופיל חברה גלויה וביקורות מאושרות. Reviewer email and phone are not returned.

tools.name: get_solar_facts
tools.description: Return verified 2026 price ranges, the feed-in text, and the calculator assumptions. טווחי מחיר מאומתים, טקסט התעריף, והנחות המחשבון. Missing tax or VAT figures stay null.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_consultation_link
tools.description: Build a WhatsApp link to נגה, a site link, and a /go/wa handoff. בניית קישור לוואטסאפ של נגה, קישור לאתר, וקישור /go/wa. Do not send a name, phone, or email. The text does not name an installer and does not promise a number of quotes. Read-only link generation.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, list_companies, get_company, get_solar_facts, get_whatsapp_consultation_link · Public sink: get_company, get_whatsapp_consultation_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, list_companies, get_company, get_solar_facts, get_whatsapp_consultation_link · Public sink: get_company, get_whatsapp_consultation_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
